name: com.cwcbb.cwcstatsystem
displayName: CwcStatSystem - High-Performance RPG Stat & Attribute System
description: A high-performance, zero-allocation RPG stat and modifier calculation system for Unity. Features PoE-style multi-tier multiplier formulas (Flat, Increased, More, Override), native interval range algebra, dual-channel synergy stat scaling, lazy dirty-flag baking, and strongly-typed code generation.
